digest.component_or_area: reconciler package structure and import system
propositions: The generic top-level `rebar_reconciler` name breaks namespace hygiene and forces a `sys.modules` key contract onto ~340 test files; it must be renamed to `rebar.reconciler` with no backward-compatibility shim.

Hand-rolled by-path loaders in ~47 source files use `spec_from_file_location` or `lazy_load` to dynamically load reconciler modules; these must be deleted and replaced with standard `importlib.import_module` calls.

Missing pipeline modules currently converge silently due to fallback no-ops and `ImportError` suppressions in loaders and prologues; after deletion of loaders, missing modules must raise `ImportError` unconditionally, causing exit code 1.

The `.github/complexity-baseline.json` file contains 6 function complexity keys under the old `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/...` prefix that must be re-spelled to `src/rebar/reconciler/...` with ceilings unchanged and the map re-sorted.

The package move requires operator-sanctioned override of the `Complexity-baseline lock` CI gate because path rewrites register as both key removals and additions; the override is a one-time administrative action for this change only.

Out-of-package callers using `_engine_module`, `_ref_lock_module`, and `_load_engine_mode` loaders must switch to `import_module`, and `sys.path.insert` sites across `_cli`, `_commands`, and `_engine_support` modules must use plain imports after the reconciler becomes a sibling package.
